Please plan a site visit to inspect
cablings from BT4 to PLC KF6, looking for loose connection/false, contact/shortcircuit, as per scheme below:

MLFB:  8EM5903-0AA00-1AA3
Additionally, for checking another error related to main fan GQ1, please refer the KA for your
reference.

.

8EM5903-0AA00-4AA2 -GQ1 Radial Fan 355mm 230V.
